segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome back to another edition here at EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到 EnglishPod 又一期节目。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: And my name is Catherine and today we've got a great upper intermediate level lesson for you all about animal and human rights.
segments.zh: 我是凯瑟琳，今天我们为大家准备了一节很棒的中高级课程，主题是动物和人权。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So it's a very debatable topic.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个非常有争议的话题。

segments.en: People want to protect animals, mistreatment of animals.
segments.zh: 人们想要保护动物，虐待动物。

segments.en: And this is what we're going to talk about today, protecting animals and giving them rights.
segments.zh: 这就是我们今天要谈论的，保护动物并赋予它们权利。

segments.en: Do you think animals have rights?
segments.zh: 你认为动物有权利吗？

segments.en: Eh, well, you know, I think we could leave that for the end.
segments.zh: 嗯，你知道，我认为我们可以把它留到最后。

segments.en: I don't want to, you know, influence the argument here in today's dialogue.
segments.zh: 你知道，我不想在今天的对话中影响这里的论点。

segments.en: But yeah, as you've said, I think it's very much a topic that people can go both ways on.
segments.zh: 但是，是的，正如你所说，我认为这是一个人们看法可能截然不同的话题。

segments.en: So why don't we listen to our dialogue as two people discuss animal rights and let's get their opinions on things.
segments.zh: 那么，我们来听对话，看看两个人讨论动物权利，听听他们各自的看法。

segments.en: You should have seen the TV show that was on last night.
segments.zh: 你真该看看昨晚那个电视节目。

segments.en: The topic it covered was really interesting.
segments.zh: 它讨论的话题很有意思。

segments.en: Animal rights.
segments.zh: 动物权利。

segments.en: Do you really believe in that?
segments.zh: 你真的相信吗？

segments.en: If they're going to focus on something, they should do it on civil rights.
segments.zh: 真要关注什么的话，他们应该多关注公民权利。

segments.en: Yes, but we can't deny that animals are vulnerable, defenseless and are completely at the mercy of human beings.
segments.zh: 是的，但我们不能否认动物是脆弱的、手无寸铁的，完全受人类的摆布。

segments.en: I understand your point, but we continue to have transgressions against human rights.
segments.zh: 我理解你的观点，但我们仍然存在侵犯人权的罪行。

segments.en: If so much attention weren't devoted to the topic of animals, we would then concentrate more on saving a human being instead of protecting a koala.
segments.zh: 如果没有把注意力集中在动物的话题上，我们会更多地专注于拯救人类，而不是保护考拉。

segments.en: You can't compare apples and oranges.
segments.zh: 这两件事不能混为一谈。

segments.en: I believe that both topics are important and that we can't ignore them.
segments.zh: 我相信这两个主题都很重要，我们不能忽视它们。

segments.en: The mistreatment of animals can cause a great environmental imbalance.
segments.zh: 对动物的虐待可能会导致严重的环境失衡。

segments.en: I believe that governments should prohibit activities like poaching.
segments.zh: 我相信政府应该禁止偷猎等活动。

segments.en: Well, you are right on that point.
segments.zh: 好吧，你在这一点上是对的。

segments.en: This is the reason that I don't buy leather and I try to buy synthetic products.
segments.zh: 这就是我不买皮革的原因，我尝试购买合成产品。

segments.en: At least you're doing your part.
segments.zh: 至少你在尽自己的一份力。

segments.en: My contribution is to have a pet in the house that I treat like a member of the family.
segments.zh: 我的贡献是在家里养一只宠物，我把它当作家庭成员对待。

segments.en: As long as you don't treat it better than your wife, it's fine.
segments.zh: 只要你对它不比对你妻子还好，那就没事。

segments.en: All right, we're back and both of them have good points, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，我们回来了，他们两个都有很好的观点，对吧？

segments.en: In favor and against.
segments.zh: 赞成和反对。

segments.en: As you said, they also talk about human rights, which is also a very important topic.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，他们也谈论人权，这也是一个非常重要的话题。

segments.en: But before we discuss this topic, why don't we take a look at the language that was used now in Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 但在我们讨论这个话题之前，我们为什么不看看现在语言要点中使用的语言。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: All right, so in Language Takeaway, our first word today is vulnerable.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以在语言要点中，我们今天的第一个词是脆弱的。

segments.en: Okay, vulnerable is a great word.
segments.zh: 好吧，脆弱是一个很好的词。

segments.en: It's a way to describe something.
segments.zh: 这是一种描述某事的方式。

segments.en: And so something is vulnerable if it can't really protect itself.
segments.zh: 因此，如果某些东西不能真正保护自己，它是脆弱的。

segments.en: So you are in danger of being hurt.
segments.zh: 所以你有受伤的危险。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So you're vulnerable.
segments.zh: 所以你很脆弱。

segments.en: Now, this isn't only used for animals, right?
segments.zh: 现在，这不仅仅用于动物，对吧？

segments.en: It can be like an army is vulnerable if they don't have strong defenses on the borders.
segments.zh: 如果他们在边界上没有强大的防御能力，就好像一支军队很脆弱。

segments.en: Or my emotions.
segments.zh: 或者我的情绪。

segments.en: I'm feeling vulnerable because I just had a really horrible week and I'm really depressed and I'm emotionally vulnerable.
segments.zh: 我感到很脆弱，因为我刚刚度过了非常可怕的一周，我真的很沮丧，而且我在情感上很脆弱。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So vulnerable.
segments.zh: 太脆弱了。

segments.en: And they also talked about transgressions against human rights.
segments.zh: 他们还谈到了侵犯人权的行为。

segments.en: All right, so a transgression is a thing.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以 transgression 是个名词。

segments.en: It's a noun.
segments.zh: 这是个名词。

segments.en: And transgression is like doing something harmful to or against someone or something.
segments.zh: 而 transgression 就是做出伤害或侵犯某人、某事的行为。

segments.en: So a transgression, it's a noun.
segments.zh: 所以 transgression 是个名词。

segments.en: So is it doing something in a bad way?
segments.zh: 那么它是否以糟糕的方式做某事？

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: It's a bad thing.
segments.zh: 这是一件坏事。

segments.en: It's always negative.
segments.zh: 它总是负面的。

segments.en: It's not positive, right?
segments.zh: 这不是积极的，对吧？

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And so in many prayers, for example, in the Christian faith, you say, you know, Lord, forgive me for my transgressions, for having kind of crossed the line from doing good things to bad things.
segments.zh: 因此，在许多祈祷中，例如，在基督教信仰中，你说，你知道，主啊，原谅我的过犯，因为我已经跨越了从做好事到坏事的界限。

segments.en: So you're doing bad things.
segments.zh: 所以你在做坏事。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So that's a good way of putting it, to cross the line, to kind of go beyond where you should.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个很好的方式，越界，超越你应该的地方。

segments.en: All right, so transgressions.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以就是 transgressions。

segments.en: And now another very serious problem in the world is poaching.
segments.zh: 现在世界上另一个非常严重的问题是偷猎。

segments.en: That's one of the things that they said they should control, poaching.
segments.zh: 这是他们说他们应该控制的事情之一，偷猎。

segments.en: You might have heard this word in a different context because it does have another meaning, but I'm just going to explain the one meaning here that we're talking about, which is killing animals, especially for sport or for selling their skins and their furs.
segments.zh: 你可能在不同的上下文中听说过这个词，因为它确实有另一种含义，但我只是要解释我们在这里谈论的一种含义，即杀死动物，特别是用于运动或出售它们的皮肤和皮毛。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So that's poaching.
segments.zh: 所以这是偷猎。

segments.en: What's the difference between poaching and hunting?
segments.zh: 偷猎和狩猎有什么区别？

segments.en: Hunting can be legal.
segments.zh: 狩猎可以是合法的。

segments.en: Poaching is illegal.
segments.zh: 偷猎是违法的。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So that's the main difference.
segments.zh: 所以这是主要区别。

segments.en: Hunting is usually for sport.
segments.zh: 狩猎通常是为了运动。

segments.en: You hunt either for food or for sport, right?
segments.zh: 你要么是为了食物，要么是为了运动，对吧？

segments.en: Legal hunting.
segments.zh: 合法狩猎。

segments.en: But poaching is usually you want to sell, like you said, the fur or the skins or something.
segments.zh: 但偷猎通常是你想卖掉，就像你说的，皮毛或皮肤什么的。

segments.en: Or the tusks on rhinos or something like that.
segments.zh: 或者犀牛上的象牙或类似的东西。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: All right, so poaching.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以偷猎。

segments.en: And then they talked about synthetic products.
segments.zh: 然后他们谈到了合成产品。

segments.en: So what is a synthetic product?
segments.zh: 那么什么是合成产品呢？

segments.en: Well, synthetic product is something that is man-made.
segments.zh: 好吧，合成产品是人造的。

segments.en: So it's not natural in that it doesn't come from the earth.
segments.zh: 所以它不是天然的，因为它不是来自自然界的。

segments.en: Cotton is a natural product and plastic, for example, is synthetic or another example.
segments.zh: 棉花是一种天然产品，而塑料是合成的，或者再举一个例子。

segments.en: Or nylon.
segments.zh: 或尼龙。

segments.en: Nylon is a really good synthetic product.
segments.zh: 尼龙是一种非常好的合成产品。

segments.en: And so people who don't want to use animal products like wool or leather, they prefer to use synthetic products.
segments.zh: 因此，不想使用羊毛或皮革等动物产品的人更喜欢使用合成产品。

segments.en: And I think maybe you've heard this in clothing.
segments.zh: 我想也许你在服装中听说过。

segments.en: It's called synthetic fibers, right?
segments.zh: 它被称为合成纤维，对吧？

segments.en: Like nylon or polyester.
segments.zh: 像尼龙或聚酯。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: These are all the words that we have for language takeaway today.
segments.zh: 这些都是我们今天为语言要点所用的所有词。

segments.en: So why don't we move on now to a couple of very interesting phrases that we saw in the dialogue now in Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 那么，我们现在为什么不继续讨论我们在流利表达的对话中看到的一些非常有趣的短语。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: Okay, this first phrase is, well, it's a common one, but it's definitely not used in very happy circumstances.
segments.zh: 好吧，第一个短语，嗯，很常见，但它绝对不是用在什么愉快的场合。

segments.en: We say that something or someone is at the mercy of someone else.
segments.zh: 我们说某事或某人受他人的摆布。

segments.en: Okay, so animals are at the mercy of human beings.
segments.zh: 好吧，动物是受人摆布的。

segments.en: What does this mean exactly?
segments.zh: 这究竟是什么意思？

segments.en: Mercy?
segments.zh: 怜悯？

segments.en: So basically, it means that the animals, in this case, don't have control of what's going on.
segments.zh: 所以基本上，这意味着动物，在这种情况下，无法控制正在发生的事情。

segments.en: So human beings are the ones that control everything.
segments.zh: 所以人类是控制一切的人。

segments.en: So if I decide to kill them, then they are at my mercy, at my will, at my whim.
segments.zh: 所以如果我决定杀死它们，它们就任我摆布，随我心愿、随我一时兴起。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And so you could say, I'm at your mercy, Marco, please just like help me out with this.
segments.zh: 所以你可以说，我任由你摆布，马可，请帮我解决这个问题。

segments.en: It's like you're the one in control.
segments.zh: 就像你才是掌控局面的人。

segments.en: You're the one who can help the situation.
segments.zh: 你是能帮上忙的那个人。

segments.en: Will you help?
segments.zh: 你会帮忙吗？

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: I'm at the mercy of someone.
segments.zh: 我任由某人摆布。

segments.en: And then they were talking and debating this thing and an interesting comparison came up.
segments.zh: 然后他们正在谈论和辩论这件事，并出现了一个有趣的比较。

segments.en: You can't compare apples and oranges.
segments.zh: 你不能比较苹果和橙子。

segments.en: All right, you're going to hear this all the time in English.
segments.zh: 好吧，你会一直用英语听到这个。

segments.en: It's not just a funny little phrase that the person uses.
segments.zh: 这不仅仅是一个有趣的小短语。

segments.en: It's a very common idiom.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常常见的成语。

segments.en: And so we say, it's like apples and oranges or you can't compare apples and oranges.
segments.zh: 所以我们说，它就像苹果和橙子，或者你无法比较苹果和橙子。

segments.en: And this is essentially saying, these are two different things.
segments.zh: 这基本上是在说，这是两个不同的东西。

segments.en: Completely different.
segments.zh: 完全不同。

segments.en: Completely different.
segments.zh: 完全不同。

segments.en: So I can't compare him and her because it's apples and oranges.
segments.zh: 所以我不能比较他和她，因为它是苹果和橙子。

segments.en: They're two different things, two different people.
segments.zh: 它们是两种不同的东西，两个不同的人。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Because that's what in the movie, you said they were like peas and carrots.
segments.zh: 因为这就是电影中的内容，你说它们就像豌豆和胡萝卜。

segments.en: They just go together well.
segments.zh: 他们只是很好地结合在一起。

segments.en: They just go together.
segments.zh: 它们就是很搭。

segments.en: Does that make sense?
segments.zh: 这么说你能理解吗？

segments.en: Not really.
segments.zh: 不太明白。

segments.en: Forrest Gump was a little bit strange like that.
segments.zh: 福雷斯特·阿甘（Forrest Gump）有点奇怪。

segments.en: But I think the meaning is that if I say that's a big apple and I say that's a small apple, they're all apples so I can compare them.
segments.zh: 但我认为意思是，如果我说那是一个大苹果，我说那是一个小苹果，它们都是苹果，所以我可以比较它们。

segments.en: But I say this is a really big orange and that's a really big apple.
segments.zh: 但我说这是一个很大的橙子，那是一个很大的苹果。

segments.en: Well, they're different.
segments.zh: 嗯，他们是不同的。

segments.en: You just can't compare them.
segments.zh: 你只是无法比较它们。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And towards the end, the person said that you're doing your part.
segments.zh: 最后，那个人说你正在尽自己的一份力量。

segments.en: You're doing your part.
segments.zh: 你正在尽自己的一份力量。

segments.en: Yeah, so this is a hard one to understand sometimes because it's not like a part in a play.
segments.zh: 是的，所以这有时很难理解，因为它不像是戏剧中的一个角色。

segments.en: It's more like a part in society.
segments.zh: 它更像是社会的一部分。

segments.en: You're helping make society or culture or civilization better.
segments.zh: 您正在帮助使社会或文化或文明变得更好。

segments.en: So you're contributing.
segments.zh: 所以你在贡献。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So for example, what would be an example of a person doing their part towards society?
segments.zh: 那么，例如，一个人对社会做出自己的贡献的例子是什么？

segments.en: Well, for example, I don't own a car.
segments.zh: 好吧，例如，我没有汽车。

segments.en: I ride my bike and it's my way of doing my part to help the environment.
segments.zh: 我骑自行车，这是我尽我所能帮助环境的方式。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So I can't, obviously, I can't buy a factory that's very green or I can't do all these things to change the world.
segments.zh: 所以我不能，显然，我不能买一个非常绿色的工厂，或者我不能做所有这些事情来改变世界。

segments.en: So I'm going to do small things that those are my way of doing my part.
segments.zh: 所以我会做一些小事，这些就是尽我一份力的方式。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So like another example would be recycling.
segments.zh: 所以就像另一个例子是回收。

segments.en: That's doing your part.
segments.zh: 那就是尽自己的一份力。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Or in this case, the person bought only synthetic products, nothing made from nature.
segments.zh: 或者在这个例子中，这个人只买合成产品，不买任何天然材料制成的东西。

segments.en: All right, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So very interesting phrases.
segments.zh: 非常有趣的短语。

segments.en: Why don't we listen to our dialogue for the last time and then we'll be right back.
segments.zh: 为什么我们不听我们最后一次的对话，然后我们会马上回来。

segments.en: You should have seen the TV show that was on last night.
segments.zh: 你真该看看昨晚那个电视节目。

segments.en: The topic it covered was really interesting.
segments.zh: 它讨论的话题很有意思。

segments.en: Animal rights.
segments.zh: 动物权利。

segments.en: Do you really believe in that?
segments.zh: 你真的相信吗？

segments.en: If they're going to focus on something, they should do it on civil rights.
segments.zh: 真要关注什么的话，他们应该多关注公民权利。

segments.en: Yes, but we can't deny that animals are vulnerable, defenseless, and are completely at the mercy of human beings.
segments.zh: 是的，但我们不能否认动物是脆弱的、手无寸铁的，完全受人类的摆布。

segments.en: I understand your point, but we continue to have transgressions against human rights.
segments.zh: 我理解你的观点，但我们仍然存在侵犯人权的罪行。

segments.en: If so much attention weren't devoted to the topic of animals, we would then concentrate more on saving a human being instead of protecting a koala.
segments.zh: 如果没有把注意力集中在动物的话题上，我们会更多地专注于拯救人类，而不是保护考拉。

segments.en: You can't compare apples and oranges.
segments.zh: 你不能比较苹果和橙子。

segments.en: I believe that both topics are important and that we can't ignore them.
segments.zh: 我相信这两个主题都很重要，我们不能忽视它们。

segments.en: The mistreatment of animals can cause a great environmental imbalance.
segments.zh: 对动物的虐待可能会导致严重的环境失衡。

segments.en: I believe that governments should prohibit activities like poaching.
segments.zh: 我相信政府应该禁止偷猎等活动。

segments.en: Well, you are right on that point.
segments.zh: 好吧，你在这一点上是对的。

segments.en: This is the reason that I don't buy leather and I try to buy synthetic products.
segments.zh: 这就是我不买皮革的原因，我尝试购买合成产品。

segments.en: At least you're doing your part.
segments.zh: 至少你在尽自己的一份力量。

segments.en: My contribution is to have a pet in the house that I treat like a member of the family.
segments.zh: 我的贡献是在家里养一只宠物，我把它当作家庭成员对待。

segments.en: As long as you don't treat it better than your wife, it's fine.
segments.zh: 只要你对它不比对你妻子还好，那就没事。

segments.en: All right, so a debatable topic, animals and animal rights.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以一个有争议的话题，动物和动物的权利。

segments.en: What do you think?
segments.zh: 你觉得怎么样？

segments.en: Well, I'll say this.
segments.zh: 嗯，我会这么说。

segments.en: I would be a hypocrite if I said that it's bad to hurt animals because I'm a meat eater.
segments.zh: 如果我说伤害动物是不好的，我会是个伪君子，因为我是一个肉食者。

segments.en: I like to eat meat and I like to wear leather.
segments.zh: 我喜欢吃肉，我喜欢穿皮革。

segments.en: But I do think it's bad to mistreat animals.
segments.zh: 但我确实认为虐待动物是不好的。

segments.en: So I try to buy free-range chicken or meat from places I know that treat the animals well and I definitely disagree with poaching and with using animals, especially endangered animals for money and cash purposes.
segments.zh: 所以我尽量买散养鸡肉，或从我知道善待动物的商家那里买肉；我绝对反对偷猎，也反对为了金钱利益而利用动物，尤其是濒危动物。

segments.en: And so that's my position.
segments.zh: 这就是我的立场。

segments.en: But what's yours?
segments.zh: 但你的是什么？

segments.en: I mean, I know you eat meat too.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，我知道你也吃肉。

segments.en: No, yeah, of course.
segments.zh: 不，是的，当然。

segments.en: And I think even though protection of animals is a very important topic and you don't want the mistreatment of these little creatures that are very vulnerable to us because we're smarter than them in the end.
segments.zh: 而且我认为，虽然保护动物是个非常重要的话题，你也不希望这些对我们来说很脆弱的小生命受到虐待，毕竟我们比它们聪明。

segments.en: But I think also it has to do a lot with superstition sometimes and kind of mystical and magical things.
segments.zh: 但我觉得这有时也和迷信、和那些神秘玄妙的东西有很大关系。

segments.en: For example, people killing rhinos because they believe that the rhino horn has amazing curing properties or the same thing with elephant tusks and stuff like that.
segments.zh: 例如，人们猎杀犀牛，是因为他们相信犀牛角有神奇的疗效，象牙之类的东西也是一样。

segments.en: So it also involves this certain aspect that people almost don't know any better.
segments.zh: 所以这也牵涉到一点：人们几乎是不明就里。

segments.en: They just truly believe that these things actually work or that they will help them.
segments.zh: 他们只是真正相信这些事情确实有效，或者它们会帮助他们。

segments.en: So they don't consider the, like in the dialogue said, the imbalance that they create in the environment or the consequences.
segments.zh: 所以他们不考虑——就像对话里说的——他们给环境造成的失衡，或是那些后果。

segments.en: Or there might be some very serious evolutionary consequences that we cannot even imagine.
segments.zh: 或者可能会有一些我们甚至无法想象的非常严重的进化后果。

segments.en: And so, you know, things change kind of over time, sometimes quickly and sometimes slowly.
segments.zh: 所以，你知道，随着时间的推移，事情会发生某种变化，有时很快，有时也很慢。

segments.en: But if we force change really quickly, who knows what the results are going to be.
segments.zh: 但如果我们强行让改变来得太快，谁知道结果会怎样。

segments.en: It might be really negative for us.
segments.zh: 这对我们来说可能真的是负面的。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And that's what we want to know now.
segments.zh: 这就是我们现在想知道的。

segments.en: What do you think about these topics?
segments.zh: 您对这些主题有何看法？

segments.en: Because in the end, the environment, animals, they're all connected.
segments.zh: 因为最终，环境，动物，它们都是相互联系的。

segments.en: If you wipe out all the foxes in a forest, then you're going to have too many snakes running around, right?
segments.zh: 如果你消灭了森林里所有的狐狸，那你就会有太多的蛇跑来跑去，对吧？

segments.en: So what do you think?
segments.zh: 那你怎么看？

segments.en: Come to EnglishPod.com where you can leave all your questions, comments or suggestions.
segments.zh: 访问 Englishpod.com，您可以在其中留下您的所有问题、意见或建议。

segments.en: And we're always there to help out.
segments.zh: 我们总是在那里提供帮助。

segments.en: So we hope to see you there.
segments.zh: 所以我们希望在那里见到你。

segments.en: And until next time, everyone, goodbye.
segments.zh: 直到下一次，大家再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
